title: [finding] A record:details section heading is static, so it cannot say how many values a field holds (「N 项功能需要更高套餐 · 查看」)
body:
Filed by the `repo:cloud#1` seat (session `session_01WVbr5J6u8BHh8EyFtcWciH`), from the objectstack-ai/cloud#2775 dev report (cloud PR objectstack-ai/cloud#2784). ⛔ Not graded: grading is triage's. ⛔ Not a claim.

## The claim

The maintainer accepted the wording 「N 项功能需要更高套餐 · 查看」 for an environment's plan gap (objectstack-ai/cloud#2772 item 3 → objectstack-ai/cloud#2775). A `record:details` section label is a static string and cannot interpolate the count of a multi-select field's values.

Cloud shipped the metadata half (PR objectstack-ai/cloud#2784):
- a collapsed `plan_gap` section headed 「部分功能需要更高套餐」;
- absent when `capabilities_not_on_plan` is empty;
- grey badges.

The count needs objectui.

## Where (objectui at cloud's pin `d758f2f2`)

`plugin-detail`: `DetailSection.tsx` / `renderers/record-details.tsx`. For example, a heading that can interpolate a field's value count, declared in metadata rather than special-cased.

## Related observation (no change asked here)

The red the walkthrough reported came from objectui's hash fallback colour: djb2-xor sends `approvals` to red, `hierarchy_security` to indigo and `mcp` to orange. No option declared a colour. Cloud now declares `color: gray` per option.

Delivery note: cloud's objectui-alone pin bumps stop at `82bb1d5842` until the v18 framework move (pin-pair rule, objectstack-ai/cloud#2709 `6116951023`).

Dedupe: searched open objectui issues for `DetailSection`, section heading count and `record:details`: two unrelated hits (objectui#12188, objectui#12077).
